title: Underlying multiplication short exact sequence for evaluated reduction
statement: Let ell be prime, W a scheme, and D a simultaneous derived reduction [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface]. Let P be an integral sheaf complex on which every ell^(n+1) is monic degreewise. For each n the actual quotient-unit map from P to the underlying n-th ordinary reduction, applied termwise with the identity and composition comparisons, gives a short exact complex sequence P --ell^(n+1)--> P --> U(E(P)_n). Its middle arrow is exactly the one in the complexes formula of [lem-sfb-diagonal-evaluation-unit].

source.place: Steps (2) and (3), the common two-term resolution and its (ell,1) transition.

proof.text: Use ordinary_level_comparison from the module realizing diagonal reduction completion. It identifies the underlying p-adic quotient with the integral cokernel and carries the scalar-adjunction quotient unit to the integral quotient map.

The integral reductionPresentation from the derived-reduction existence construction exhibits this quotient as an actual cokernel. The given monomorphism makes the integral multiplication sequence short exact in each degree.

Compute the termwise components of the identity/composition comparisons. Transport the short exact sequence by the quotient isomorphism, then apply the degreewise short exactness criterion for complexes.

theorem diagonal_evaluation_complex_shortExact
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ W)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ W))
    (P : CochainComplex (DiagonalAb W) ℤ)
    (hP : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), Mono (ℓ ^ (n + 1) • 𝟙 (P.X i))) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ hz : (ℓ ^ (n + 1) • 𝟙 P) ≫
        diagonalEvaluationComplexMap (diagonalForget ℓ W) (diagonalScalarAdjunction ℓ W)
          D n P = 0,
      (ShortComplex.mk _ _ hz).ShortExact
